prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
finish, new_flow changes are helpful, yielding 5 wins (+11.1%, +7.1%, +3.6%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 5 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, yielding 4 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), while 6 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in, reorder is high-risk with 1 win and 2 severe losses, while adoption, redesign and sign_in, layout failed to deliver any wins.
adoption, copy; adoption, layout; sign_in, hint; and home, notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across iterations.
Single-test kinds (e.g., adoption, incentive; choose_path, layout; sign_in, copy) still have thin evidence and do not form established patterns.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak or failing changes while underestimating unexpected major wins.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Pet Care Interactive Warmup Flow: Adds an interactive practice activity on the final intro screen where users test feeding and tapping their pet before going to the desktop. (why: The finish step has a high mean duration (5815s) and support emails report confusion on how to interact with pets after onboarding. Finish new_flow changes have delivered consistent wins.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion Desktop Orientation Screen: Introduces a dedicated final onboarding screen showing visual instructions for summoning, toggling, and closing desktop pets. (why: 3 support tickets note confusion around how to control or hide pets, and finish stage improvements drive significant onboarding completion gains.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Milestone Stage Progress: Updates the generation waiting screen with explicit real-time step badges and a progress countdown. (why: Home screen waiting has a mean duration of 2336s and wait_info changes on home stage have yielded multiple past wins (+4.1%, +3.1%).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Review Screen: Inserts a photo review screen before adoption certification to confirm generated trait details before finalizing. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (67.9% conversion) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation quality issues.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Trait Hatching Countdown: Displays interactive trait hatching tips and remaining time markers during the pet generation wait screen. (why: The waiting step accounts for significant drop-off time (mean 2336s). Providing transparent wait stage details improves retention during long loads.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Mode Orientation Overview Screen: Adds an intro overview screen before path selection that explains the core differences between Story and Companion paths. (why: Median path selection time is 8s while mean duration spikes to 514s, showing a split between instant clicks and stuck users.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Choice: Allows users to choose a starter decorative ribbon badge on their adoption certificate before proceeding. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 67.9%. Adding personalized micro-customization increases emotional attachment and completion.)
7: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Taskbar Setup Flow: Guides users through pinning the pet shortcut to their desktop taskbar on the final onboarding screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported issues with pets not appearing on desktop or being unable to re-open the app after closing.)
